# Syncophant

> Syncophant is a free, open-source macOS app that puts remote storage in Finder, as a location next to Macintosh HD. It connects to SFTP servers, WebDAV, S3-compatible object storage and SMB shares. No account, no telemetry. Needs macOS 26 or later.

- Files download when opened and take no space until then. Folders can be kept on the Mac for offline use.
- An upload counts as verified only when the copy on your storage has the same SHA-256 checksum as the Mac. Uploads whose checksum can't be confirmed show "Uploaded · not verified".
- Conflicting edits produce a conflict copy; nothing is overwritten.
- Passwords and keys are stored in the macOS Keychain. The app connects only to your storage, to Hetzner's API if you add a Hetzner token, and to GitHub when you check for updates.
- Connection types: SFTP (password, private key or SSH agent; the server must run sha256sum), WebDAV over HTTPS, S3-compatible object storage over HTTPS (no one-step rename, so it copies and the trash is off), and SMB shares that require SMB3 encryption and signing.
- Hetzner Storage Boxes get a guided setup: paste an API token and Syncophant creates a sub-account limited to one folder.
- License: app GPL-3.0-or-later, storage libraries MIT. Syncophant is an early build; keep another copy of important files.
